Hi Avery / Marissa,

We're kicking off our security intake for the upcoming vendor review. Given our aggressive timeline, we'd love to compress the standard SOC 2 walkthrough, pen-test intake and a quick DPA review into a single coordinated session (60 minutes total) if that works on your end. Goal: high-level controls walkthrough, pen-test scope confirmation, and signal on evidence transfer / DPA items.

Attendees from our side: myself (security lead), Lina Park (infra PM), and procurement (will listen in). Timezone: PDT — our preferred windows next week are 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00 PDT.

I've attached a short questionnaire with our initial questions and a proposed list of evidence we may request. Let us know whether Redwood prefers a two-part split (45min controls + 15min DPA/contract items) or a single compact agenda.

Hi Daniel — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. We can absolutely run a compact session; appreciate the clarity on attendees and windows.

Proposal (to keep to 60 minutes):
- 0–10 min: Introductions + scope definitions (Redwood: high-level architecture and hosting modes)
- 10–40 min: SOC 2 controls walkthrough (key control families, evidence paths) — Marissa will lead this portion.
- 40–55 min: Pen-test intake (scope, approved test types, vendor expectations) — Ben to outline pen vendor readiness.
- 55–60 min: DPA & evidence transfer logistics (who gets what, transfer mechanism) — quick alignment.

If that works, suggested slots in PDT next week: 2027-10-05 10:30 or 2027-10-06 15:30. If you prefer a strict 45/15 split, say so and we'll mark it in the invite.

Operational notes: we'll provide a temporary read-only GDrive link for evidence handoff, and Marissa will include a short checklist so you can pre-stage items. I've cc'd Ben (sales) to raise any commercial or SOW questions during the call.

Attachments: Redwood_Compact_Agenda_v1.docx (6 KB)

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
